how: applications ranked by sha256(seed:correction:id); v2 decisions forced by the hard rule skipped; 10 narrowing (v2 approve/review → stricter) and 10 widening (v2 refuse/review → more permissive), a review one going to the side drawn by sha256(seed:direction:id); the 8 lowest sha256(seed:scope:id) are overreach; corrected decision drawn by sha256(seed:to:id) where two are possible. Exact condition: equalities on declared fields in a fixed order until only this application matches among the 1,000; overreach: the first of a fixed list of broad conditions that also changes another application's decision. No condition matches a boundary test input (boundaries.json). Widening (§0.8): the corrected decision is more permissive on any matched input (refuse < review < approve).
